evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/neighbors/hooks/useNeighbors.ts:117 — useNeighbors memoes `getNeighborsApiClient()` with [] deps; api is captured once at mount with the token present then

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/neighbors/hooks/useNeighbors.ts:138 — usePrivacySettings has the same [] deps pattern; the api that drives both the read + the update mutation is pinned to the mount-time token

frontend/packages/api-client/src/neighbors/api.ts:30 — createNeighborsApi() calls buildHeaders(config) ONCE and freezes the Bearer-token `Authorization` header into every subsequent listNeighbors / getPrivacySettings / updatePrivacySettings fetch; this is raw fetch, so there is no axios interceptor to re-inject the rotated token

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/messaging/hooks/useMessaging.ts:402 — contrast: useMessageRecipients uses the SAME getNeighborsApi factory but memoes with [token] deps, so a token rotation rebuilds the api; useNeighbors.ts omits this and leaves consumers wedged on the stale token
signals.severity_rationale: +2 because: silent background token refresh is the common path for a long-lived SPA session, and once it happens every fetch and the privacy-settings update mutation on this hook pair will 401 against the raw fetch (no axios 401-replay interceptor on this transport), until the component unmounts. Not +3 because the component may re-mount on route navigation and the user can usually recover by refreshing.
